name: AI Receptionist Bot
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt

terminals.name: flask-app
terminals.command: cd /workspace && . .venv/bin/activate && export TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID="${TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID:-ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx}" && export TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN="${TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN:-dev_placeholder_token}" && export TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER="${TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER:-whatsapp:+14155238886}" && export OWNER_PHONE_NUMBER="${OWNER_PHONE_NUMBER:-whatsapp:+10000000000}" && export SECRET_KEY="${SECRET_KEY:-dev-only-secret-change-me}" && export PORT="${PORT:-5000}" && python app.py
